name: Bánh xèo chả cá
summary: Bánh xèo chả cá is the afternoon crepe filled with the island fish paste.
origin: Cham Islands. An afternoon crepe on Tân Hiệp, filled with the local fish paste.
howToEat: In the afternoon, with bánh canh, bánh bèo, and mì Quảng, for visitors and islanders.
where: The Bai Lang coast road and the stalls by Giếng Xóm Cấm in Bai Ong.
seoTitle: Bánh xèo chả cá — fish-paste crepe, Cham Islands
seoDescription: A crepe filled with the island’s fish paste, afternoon food on the Bai Lang coast road.
